item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":2,"rationale":"Executive departments and agencies must condition future federal-assistance approvals on applicants accepting specified construction-contract obligations; the legally consequential conditions arise through later agency approvals and contracts.","evidence":"require as a condition for the approval of any grant, contract, loan, insurance or guarantee"},{"segment_id":"2","code":2,"rationale":"Upon the Committee's recommendation, the administering agency must later cancel, suspend, or terminate an agreement, withhold assistance, or refer the case after applicant noncompliance; notice and a hearing precede specified funding or contractual consequences.","evidence":"upon the recommendation of the Committee, shall take any or all of the following actions"},{"segment_id":"3","code":2,"rationale":"Government contracting agencies must insert specified nondiscrimination clauses into future contracts, making the prescribed obligations binding through later contracting rather than through the amendment alone.","evidence":"all Government contracting agencies shall include in every Government contract hereafter entered into the following provisions"},{"segment_id":"4","code":1,"rationale":"The provision assigns the Committee discretionary exemption authority, changes Committee membership and internal coverage, and sets effective dates; it does not itself grant a particular exemption or dictate a later exemption outcome.","evidence":"The Committee may, when it deems that special circumstances in the national interest so require, exempt a contracting agency"}]}
